principle: definitions are not empirical assumptions; every case restriction is either directly audited, locally tested, or left unasserted

input_reconstruction.interpretation: input reconstruction is complete for archived gateway exchanges; exact-input response variation is not estimable because signatures are unique

backend_threshold_rule.source_lines: 215-220 (manually inspected source; substring guard prevents silent drift)
backend_threshold_rule.operational_rule: alive agent with energy <= 0 is terminated at _deaths check
backend_threshold_rule.symbolic_rule: _deaths returns without applying the energy mortality gate

resource_survival_case_restriction.interpretation: panel and backend source jointly validate this case-specific execution rule; symbolic-energy directly falsifies universal coupling

tier_frequency_assignment_law.evaluation: retrospective diagnostic; not a prospectively registered confirmation
tier_frequency_assignment_law.screen: reject a cell if absolute assignment-rate error exceeds 5 percentage points

pilot_response_restriction.interpretation: local pilot evidence only; does not license a general monotone response axiom

unvalidated_behavioral_restrictions: a universal mapping from resource balance to survival or action
a response law transported across population sizes, prompts, or mechanisms

assumption_registry.restriction: A finite probability law has nonnegative rational weights summing to one.
assumption_registry.check: Lean FiniteDistribution constructor and kernel build; no empirical fitting assumption.
assumption_registry.reject_rule: A law that is not normalized/nonnegative cannot be instantiated as FiniteDistribution.
assumption_registry.failure_action: Reject the mathematical input; do not run numerical forecast.

assumption_registry.restriction: Recorded resource changes equal event-level replay for every archived world.
assumption_registry.check: Zero-API replay and world-level ledger comparison.
assumption_registry.failure_action: Reject the resource-to-agent case mapping before interpreting predictions.

assumption_registry.restriction: Each archived gateway request can be reconstructed with its full agent-visible payload.
assumption_registry.check: Count complete request signatures and compare with gateway exchanges.
assumption_registry.reject_rule: Any request lacks payload, or signature count differs from exchange count.
assumption_registry.failure_action: Refuse same-input response claims for unreconstructable requests.
assumption_registry.evidence: 45180/45180 complete; exact signatures reused across worlds=0

assumption_registry.restriction: The CTF backend terminates an alive agent at energy <= 0 in non-symbolic regimes and bypasses this gate in symbolic-energy.
assumption_registry.check: Static backend source guard plus alive/energy trace cross-check.
assumption_registry.reject_rule: Backend branch changes or any non-symbolic alive observation contradicts the replayed gate.
assumption_registry.failure_action: Withdraw the energy-survival case mapping; do not use survival-currency results.
assumption_registry.evidence: source guards pass; operational negative-alive observations=0; symbolic negative-alive observations=685

assumption_registry.restriction: Every balance in the stochastic resource upper-bound application is nonnegative.
assumption_registry.check: Direct scan of all archived non-symbolic agent-day start/end balances.
assumption_registry.failure_action: Do not instantiate ResourceSurvivalBound for that regime; use a signed-resource model instead.

assumption_registry.restriction: A positive common reserve d is enforced before the continuation event being predicted.
assumption_registry.check: Read the backend death threshold and scheduled mandatory costs from the actual event sequence.
assumption_registry.reject_rule: No positive enforced reserve exists, or the checking point does not match the modeled next-period event.
assumption_registry.failure_action: Do not report the positive-reserve probability bound as a CTF survival prediction.
assumption_registry.evidence: Backend death gate is energy <= 0; direct reserve d=0 makes the positive-reserve bound uninformative.

assumption_registry.restriction: A frozen response kernel maps complete inputs and states to proposal probabilities.
assumption_registry.check: Exact-input repeats, or a preregistered low-cost paired replay experiment with fixed inputs and controlled conditions.
assumption_registry.reject_rule: Held-out proposal frequencies fall outside the predeclared predictive interval, or the supposedly fixed input/configuration changes.
assumption_registry.failure_action: Reject that response restriction; do not add post-hoc state variables to rescue it.
assumption_registry.evidence: 45180 complete archived requests; 0 exact signatures reused across worlds; existing pilot is vignette-local only.

assumption_registry.restriction: A frozen joint law predicts assignment and verified production, preserving arbitrary dependence.
assumption_registry.check: Use agent-task event joins; fit on calibration worlds and score world-level holdouts with a frozen rule.
assumption_registry.reject_rule: Any predeclared holdout statistic exceeds the frozen tolerance; current tier-frequency screen already fails 4/4 retrospective cells.
assumption_registry.failure_action: Reject that candidate law; retain only identified bounds or collect a new minimal calibration sample.
assumption_registry.evidence: retrospective tier-frequency baseline rejected in 4/4 cells; this is diagnostic, not a prospective test.

assumption_registry.check: Would require identity permutation or joint-response tests over repeated controlled populations.
assumption_registry.reject_rule: Any label-permutation or dependence diagnostic violates the preregistered tolerance.
assumption_registry.failure_action: Never impose this restriction for CTF forecasts without the test; current general interfaces allow asymmetry and dependence.
assumption_registry.evidence: Lean population interfaces and joint lotteries permit arbitrary identities and dependence.

assumption_registry.restriction: For a fixed horizon, persistence is the conjunction of period-level alive events; with absorbing exits, it equals terminal alive status.
assumption_registry.check: For each world and each of its six identities, compare all alive_end flags on days 1..8 to day-8 alive_end and scan for exit followed by re-entry.
assumption_registry.reject_rule: Any path in the positive-support case sample disagrees, or backend uses an unrecorded reset/revival event.
assumption_registry.failure_action: Do not use temporal intersection bounds for survival; retain only the full path simulator or redefine the event from audited state transitions.
assumption_registry.evidence: H=8; six named agents per world; no-reentry=24/24; persistence equals terminal alive share=24/24; interval contains persistence=24/24. Descriptive finite-population shares only, not a cross-world forecast.

assumption_registry.restriction: Lean AuthorityWorldV2Clock reproduces the v2 backend's day phase, allocation/work half-open windows, election registration gate, and inclusive task-lifetime boundary.
assumption_registry.check: Execute the actual Python config parser and runtime gate functions at open/close boundaries for every checked-in agent_econ_*.json; guard the corresponding backend source rules.
assumption_registry.reject_rule: Any source guard changes, any config violates the encoded ordering, or any runtime gate differs from the Lean boundary fixture.
assumption_registry.failure_action: Withdraw the v2 clock-to-opportunity mapping; do not use the Lean timing module for that backend until the semantics are reconciled.
assumption_registry.evidence: 8 configs; zero API; source and config hashes recorded in authority_v2_clock_audit.json

assumption_registry.restriction: Given the recorded alive set, candidate set, explicit ballots, and seed-conditioned choices, the Lean election map reproduces no-candidate, all-candidate, missing-ballot, plurality, and tie branches.
assumption_registry.check: Run the actual Python _finalize_election on boundary profiles and guard its branch semantics against the Lean case model; retain source/config hashes.
assumption_registry.reject_rule: Any backend branch, seed tag, vote-imputation rule, or tested outcome differs from the encoded case map.
assumption_registry.failure_action: Withdraw this v2 election mapping and do not use it to simulate office selection until reconciled.
assumption_registry.evidence: Zero-API synthetic branch audit; no-candidate and all-candidate paths plus a Lean-matched four-agent 1:1 plurality tie with one imputed ballot.

prediction_admissibility.reason: positive enforced reserve and accepted frozen joint response-production kernel are both absent; report execution facts, case diagnostics, or identified bounds only

temporal_persistence_case.unit: six explicitly named agents within each world; empirical finite-population share, not iid or superpopulation probability
temporal_persistence_case.interpretation: For these archived traces, no re-entry makes persistence through day 8 exactly equal terminal alive share; observed shares lie in the distribution-free intersection interval. This is a descriptive case audit, not an ex ante forecast or a population-level inference.
